description: Reusable marked grammatical selections; defaults are background conditions.
defaults: active, positive, aspect none, modal none, and declarative are not KCs

rules.name: present finite-form selection
rules.definition: Select present finite morphology and agreement conditions.
includes: present auxiliary or main-verb finite selection
rules.rationale: Present is an overt finite-form decision even when the base form is surface-syncretic.

rules.name: past finite-form selection
rules.definition: Select past finite morphology on the operator or main verb.
includes: regular/irregular past and past auxiliary selection
rules.rationale: Past is a reusable finite-form selection across aspect, voice, and polarity.

rules.name: perfect construction
rules.definition: Construct perfect HAVE and select the following past participle.
rules.rationale: Both perfect values require the same perfect auxiliary relation.

rules.name: progressive construction
rules.definition: Construct progressive BE and select the following present participle.
rules.rationale: Both progressive values require the same progressive auxiliary relation.

rules.name: canonical BE-passive
rules.definition: Construct passive BE and realize the lexical verb as a past participle.
rules.rationale: BE-passive adds an auxiliary-participle relation and changes argument realization.

rules.name: verbal negation
rules.definition: Place uncontracted NOT after the finite operator, inserting DO when required.
rules.rationale: Negative polarity requires a reusable operator-placement decision.

rules.name: polar-question formation
rules.definition: Form a yes/no question by placing the finite operator before the subject.
rules.rationale: Polar questions require a reusable clause-order operation.

rules.name: subject-WH formation
rules.definition: Realize a WH phrase as grammatical subject without question inversion solely for WH status.
rules.rationale: Subject-WH has a distinct subject realization and inversion pattern.

rules.name: non-subject-WH formation
rules.definition: Front an object/adjunct WH phrase and apply operator-subject question order.
rules.rationale: Non-subject WH combines fronting with finite question order.

rules.name: imperative clause formation
rules.definition: Realize a base-form directive/suggestion under the source-linked imperative subtype.
rules.rationale: Imperative clause formation is overt while subtype remains a realization condition.

rules.name: central modal CAN
rules.definition: Use central modal CAN followed by a base-form chain.
rules.rationale: Specific central modal selection is source-defined.
